statement: With the fixed epsilon=1, h=N=r0=0 parameter tuple and f0=1_{j_O=0}, for every s>r>=0 and every full fine state x, Delta_(r,s)f_r(x)=1_{2^s-2^(s-r)<=j_O<2^s-1}.
